title: [mvp] Setup Next.js, Tailwind, and shadcn/ui project structure
body:
### Goal
Establish the modern frontend foundation for ReviewRally with Next.js App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui primitives.

### Tasks
- Initialize Next.js project with App Router and TypeScript
- Configure Tailwind CSS with dark-mode tokens and v0.dev design aesthetic
- Set up base UI primitives (Button, Card, Table, Badge, Dialog, Skeleton, Tabs)
- Verify layout and font rendering

### Acceptance Criteria
- `npm run dev` starts cleanly without warnings
- Base layout renders responsive dark-mode theme

title: [mvp] Generate and implement v0.dev style Dashboard layout
body:
### Goal
Deliver a non-generic, high-converting B2B SaaS dashboard shell inspired by v0.dev / Lovable aesthetic.

### Tasks
- Build collapsible sidebar navigation (Overview, Reviews, Analytics, Billing, Settings)
- Build topbar with business switcher, notifications icon, and user profile
- Implement stat cards: Total Reviews, Average Rating, Negative Count, Response Rate
- Ensure full responsiveness across desktop and mobile screens

### Acceptance Criteria
- Matches v0.dev-quality dark-mode SaaS UI
- Fully responsive layout with mobile drawer and desktop sidebar

title: [mvp] Build Reviews List UI component
body:
### Goal
Create a polished, interactive Reviews List component displaying incoming customer feedback.

### Tasks
- Implement review table with columns: Author, Rating (star display), Category/Sentiment Badge, Date, Excerpt, Action
- Style sentiment badges with semantic colors (Positive: emerald, Neutral: slate/gray, Negative: rose/red)
- Add Category indicators (Food, Service, Ambiance)
- Design empty state illustration and placeholder

### Acceptance Criteria
- Renders cleanly from typed review props
- Empty state renders gracefully when no reviews are present

title: [mvp] Implement mock-service.ts for frontend
body:
### Goal
Provide an asynchronous frontend mock service matching future API contracts for independent UI development.

### Tasks
- Create `mock-service.ts` exporting TypeScript types (`Review`, `SentimentData`, `ResponseSuggestion`)
- Implement `getReviews()` with edge cases (`text: null`, `text: ""`)
- Implement `getSentiment()` with category breakdowns (Food, Service, Ambiance)
- Add realistic artificial latency (~300ms)

### Acceptance Criteria
- Frontend functions seamlessly in standalone mock mode with zero backend running
- Handles edge cases cleanly

title: [mvp] Wire Dashboard charts to mock data
body:
### Goal
Provide rich visual analytics using Recharts for sentiment distribution and review volume trends.

### Tasks
- Implement Pie/Donut Chart showing sentiment distribution (Positive, Neutral, Negative)
- Implement Area/Line Chart showing 14-day review volume trends
- Configure custom dark-mode tooltips, smooth animations, and legends

### Acceptance Criteria
- Charts render interactive tooltips, legends, and responsive containers
- Data updates seamlessly when filters or mock data change

title: [mvp] Define OpenAPI contract (openapi.yml)
body:
### Goal
Define a formal OpenAPI 3.0 contract at repository root as the single source of truth between frontend and backend.

### Tasks
- Define `GET /api/reviews` with pagination and category filters
- Define `GET /api/analytics/sentiment` with category counts and trend breakdown
- Define `POST /api/reviews/{id}/suggest-response`
- Define schemas: `Review` (text nullable), `SentimentData`, `ResponseSuggestion`, `ErrorResponse`

### Acceptance Criteria
- `openapi.yml` passes OpenAPI / Swagger 3.0 validation with zero errors
- Single source of truth for contract-first development

title: [mvp] Initialize Hono backend server
body:
### Goal
Set up a high-performance, lightweight Hono backend in `/backend` to serve REST endpoints.

### Tasks
- Initialize Hono app on Node.js adapter
- Configure CORS middleware for Next.js frontend origin
- Implement `GET /health` healthcheck endpoint
- Add dev script with hot-reload

### Acceptance Criteria
- `GET /health` returns HTTP 200 `{ status: "ok", service: "reviewrally-api" }`
- CORS preflight handles requests from frontend seamlessly

title: [mvp] Implement In-Memory storage controllers
body:
### Goal
Implement all endpoints in Hono using in-memory `Map()` storage before introducing database persistence.

### Tasks
- Seed in-memory map with initial test reviews including edge cases
- Implement review listing and filtering controllers
- Implement sentiment analytics aggregation controller
- Implement rule-based AI response suggestion controller

### Acceptance Criteria
- All endpoints match `openapi.yml` specification
- Zero database dependency required for in-memory iteration

title: [mvp] Setup Prisma schema with SQLite provider
body:
### Goal
Configure Prisma ORM with SQLite provider for robust, zero-configuration local persistence.

### Tasks
- Initialize `prisma/schema.prisma` with `provider = "sqlite"`
- Create `Review` model (`id` cuid, `author`, `text` nullable, `rating`, `sentiment`, `category`, `createdAt`, `businessId`)
- Configure `.env` with `DATABASE_URL="file:./dev.db"`

### Acceptance Criteria
- `npx prisma validate` passes with zero errors
- Schema matches OpenAPI data contract

title: [mvp] Run Prisma migrations for SQLite DB
body:
### Goal
Apply initial database migrations to create SQLite schema and generate Prisma Client.

### Tasks
- Execute `prisma migrate dev --name init`
- Verify creation of `dev.db`
- Verify generated `@prisma/client` types and export singleton client instance

### Acceptance Criteria
- Migration files committed to git
- Prisma client generated cleanly without type errors

title: [mvp] Create DB seed script for 500 test reviews
body:
### Goal
Populate SQLite database with a realistic dataset of 500 reviews spanning 14 days.

### Tasks
- Write `prisma/seed.ts` generating 500 realistic reviews across Food, Service, and Ambiance
- Include realistic star ratings, authors, and dates
- Specifically include edge case records: `text: null` and `text: ""`
- Register `prisma.seed` command in `package.json`

### Acceptance Criteria
- Running `npx prisma db seed` populates exactly 500 reviews
- Database contains verified edge case rows

title: [mvp] Connect Frontend to Hono Backend API
body:
### Goal
Swap frontend mock imports with a typed HTTP client calling the Hono backend API.

### Tasks
- Build typed API client (`lib/api.ts`) honoring `openapi.yml`
- Update Dashboard and Reviews components to fetch from backend
- Remove all mock imports from production app code

### Acceptance Criteria
- UI displays live data queried from SQLite via Hono backend
- Zero mock imports remaining in application code

title: [mvp] Implement "Suggest AI Response" API endpoint
body:
### Goal
Deliver the core AI value proposition: automated, empathetic response suggestions for negative customer reviews.

### Tasks
- Implement `POST /api/reviews/:id/suggest-response` in Hono
- Generate empathetic, professional resolution drafts conditioned on rating, sentiment, and category (Food, Service, Ambiance)
- Return HTTP 404 for nonexistent review IDs
- Wire UI modal/action button to trigger response suggestion and copy to clipboard

### Acceptance Criteria
- Returns 200 `{ suggestion: string }` with context-specific professional responses
- Returns 404 with JSON error on invalid ID

title: [mvp] Add loading states and error handling to frontend
body:
### Goal
Deliver production-grade resilient UX with skeleton loaders, error boundaries, and toast notifications.

### Tasks
- Add animated skeleton loaders for stat cards, review table rows, and charts
- Implement Error Boundary component with retry mechanism
- Add toast notifications for API success and failure states

### Acceptance Criteria
- Skeletons display smoothly under throttled network conditions
- Friendly error recovery UI displays on simulated 500 error

title: [mvp] Write Hono Integration Tests
body:
### Goal
Create automated integration tests using Vitest to verify all backend API contracts and edge cases.

### Tasks
- Configure Vitest test runner with isolated test database harness
- Test `GET /api/reviews` (pagination, filtering, null-text handling)
- Test `GET /api/analytics/sentiment` (empty database, aggregation math)
- Test `POST /api/reviews/:id/suggest-response` (200 success, 404 not found)

### Acceptance Criteria
- `npm test` runs green with 100% passing test suites
- Explicitly covers empty-DB and null-text edge cases

title: [user-test-bug] [Bug] Dashboard crashes with TypeError when a review has empty/null text body
body:
### Goal
Prevent dashboard crash on reviews containing null or empty text bodies.

### Description
When a seeded review with `text: null` is rendered in ReviewCard/ReviewRow, calling `review.text.substring(...)` throws `TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'substring')`, causing a white-screen crash.

### Repro Steps
1. Seed database with null-text review (`text: null`)
2. Open Dashboard / Reviews page
3. Frontend crashes with unhandled TypeError

### Requests
- @pm.md please groom this issue, assign priority, and define fallback UI copy.
- @qa-engineer.md please add regression test cases for null and empty text bodies.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Reviews with `null` or empty text render graceful fallback "No text provided"
- Zero console errors or crashes

title: [user-test-bug] [Bug] Sentiment pie chart shows "NaN%" when database has 0 reviews
body:
### Goal
Gracefully handle empty analytics when database has zero reviews without showing NaN.

### Description
On a fresh unseeded database where total reviews count is 0, percentage calculation divides by zero, resulting in "NaN%" rendered in chart labels and stats.

### Repro Steps
1. Launch app with fresh empty database (0 reviews)
2. Navigate to Dashboard Analytics
3. Observe sentiment chart and percentages displaying "NaN%"

### Requests
- @pm.md please groom empty-state design requirements.
- @qa-engineer.md please add zero-data analytics test cases.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Displays empty state overlay "Waiting for your first reviews…" when total reviews is 0
- Zero NaN values rendered on dashboard

title: [post-mvp] Setup CI pipeline (GitHub Actions)
body:
### Goal
Automate verification of code quality, Prisma migrations, and test suites on every pull request and push to main.

### Tasks
- Create `.github/workflows/ci.yml`
- Configure steps: checkout, node setup, dependency installation, `npx prisma validate`, `npm test`
- Verify CI passes cleanly

### Acceptance Criteria
- Workflow runs green on push/PR
- Intentionally broken test causes failure, restored code passes

title: [post-mvp] Integrate Stripe subscriptions (test-mode slice)
body:
### Goal
Implement subscription billing monetization slice with mock-fallback when Stripe API keys are not provided.

### Tasks
- Define subscription tiers: Starter ($29/mo), Pro ($79/mo), Agency ($199/mo)
- Implement `POST /api/billing/checkout` returning mock session when keys missing or real Stripe session
- Add webhook handler updating user subscription status
- Create Billing management page with tier comparison and upgrade flow

### Acceptance Criteria
- End-to-end checkout flow succeeds in test/mock mode
- Billing page accurately reflects current tier and subscription status

title: [post-mvp] Add multi-tenant authentication (NextAuth credentials slice)
body:
### Goal
Provide secure multi-tenant isolation so businesses only view and manage their own customer reviews.

### Tasks
- Configure NextAuth credentials provider with bcrypt password hashing
- Add `User` and `Business` models to SQLite schema with `businessId` relationship
- Implement row-level tenant filtering on all review queries
- Build login and registration pages matching v0.dev dark-mode styling

### Acceptance Criteria
- Two distinct seeded businesses only access their own respective reviews
- Unauthenticated API calls return HTTP 401 Unauthorized
